Redis is an open-source, in-memory data structure store used as a database, cache, message broker, and streaming engine. It supports data structures such as strings, hashes, lists, sets, and sorted sets.

{"global": {"security": {"allowInsecureImages": true}}, "image": {"registry": "jcr-prod.woowtech.io", "repository": "woow-paas-docker-local/cloud-odoo", "tag": "20260404.1645"}, "odooEmail": "user@example.com", "odooSkipInstall": false, "loadDemoData": false, "service": {"type": "ClusterIP"}, "resources": {"requests": {"cpu": "200m", "memory": "512Mi"}, "limits": {"cpu": "2000m", "memory": "2Gi"}}, "postgresql": {"enabled": true, "architecture": "standalone", "auth": {"username": "bn_odoo", "database": "bitnami_odoo"}, "image": {"registry": "docker.io", "repository": "bitnamilegacy/postgresql", "tag": "17.6.0-debian-12-r4"}}, "persistence": {"enabled": true, "size": "10Gi"}, "updateStrategy": {"type": "Recreate"}, "customPostInitScripts": {"fix-admin-credentials.sh": "#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
echo '[fix-admin-credentials] Hashing Odoo admin password with pbkdf2_sha512'
[ -z "${ODOO_PASSWORD:-}" ] && echo 'WARN: ODOO_PASSWORD not set, skipping' && exit 0
/opt/bitnami/odoo/venv/bin/python3 -c "
import os, sys
try:
 from passlib.context import CryptContext
 import psycopg2
 ctx = CryptContext(schemes=['pbkdf2_sha512'])
 hashed = ctx.hash(os.environ['ODOO_PASSWORD'])
 conn = psycopg2.connect(
 host=os.environ['ODOO_DATABASE_HOST'],
 port=int(os.environ.get('ODOO_DATABASE_PORT_NUMBER', '5432')),
 user=os.environ['ODOO_DATABASE_USER'],
 password=os.environ['ODOO_DATABASE_PASSWORD'],
 dbname=os.environ['ODOO_DATABASE_NAME'])
 cur = conn.cursor()
 cur.execute('UPDATE res_users SET password=%s WHERE id=2', (hashed,))
 conn.commit()
 cur.close()
 conn.close()
 print('[fix-admin-credentials] Password hashed successfully')
except Exception as e:
 print(f'[fix-admin-credentials] ERROR: {e}', file=sys.stderr)
 sys.exit(1)
"
", "odoo-conf-system.sh": "#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
CONF=/opt/bitnami/odoo/conf/odoo.conf
echo '[odoo-conf-system] Injecting system-level odoo.conf settings'
[ ! -f "$CONF" ] && echo "WARN: $CONF not found, skipping" && exit 0
grep -q '^proxy_mode' "$CONF" || echo 'proxy_mode = True' >> "$CONF"
grep -q '^list_db' "$CONF" || echo 'list_db = False' >> "$CONF"
echo '[odoo-conf-system] Settings injected'
"}}
